items.quote: Rejection is a myth. Consider this: You started without a customer at the beginning of your pitch, and at the end of your sales pitch, you still don’t have a customer.
Instead of perceiving it as a loss, view every opportunity as a chance to gain.
items.statement: View every opportunity as a chance to gain.

items.quote: High performance, whether in an industry or sport, sets individuals apart from the average performer by their ability to maintain a neutral attitude and perceive rejection as a mere response, NOT as a FAILURE.
items.statement: High performance sets individuals apart by their ability to maintain a neutral attitude and perceive rejection as a mere response.

items.quote: Instead of fixating on positive responses, or the “yes” from clients, shift your focus to the number of attempts you make each day in your prospecting of clients.
items.statement: Shift focus to the number of attempts you make each day in prospecting.

items.quote: As a real estate agent, a good number is between 15 to 20 conversations a day with new clients.
items.statement: A good number for a real estate agent is between 15 to 20 conversations a day with new clients.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the concept of rejection in sales and how to shift perspective.
